verdict.rationale: OpenTofu supports bulk operations via for_each-driven dynamic provider/resource generation, graph-based parallelization of non-dependent resources, and -exclude flags to scope bulk applies/plans, which are relevant to an AI-native user automating many items at once. However, this is IaC-level bulk config generation, not an AI-agent-oriented batch/automation API, and there's no evidence of programmatic bulk orchestration tailored for AI agents. missing for 10: dedicated AI-agent bulk-operation API/interface, independent hands-on verification of large-scale bulk runs, and documentation specifically framing this for AI-native automation.
